svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Architecture
svg.desc: The model report describes encoder-only prefill. The inspected publisher Transformer.forward iterates the whole backbone. This chapter explains the architecture and labels that execution distinction; it does not certify the optimization.
